sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Profile Summary
Business Analyst / Functional Consultant with 8.6 years of experience in Banking and Financial Services, including 6 years of dedicated Business Analysis experience. Strong domain expertise in Trade Finance, Core Banking and Digital Banking, with hands-on experience across Letter of Credit (LC), Import Finance, Export Finance, Import & Export Bills, Bank Guarantee (BG), Foreign Remittances, FDI and ODI. Analysed and documented Treasury, Credit, Market, Liquidity Risk, and AML requirements, covering risk exposure, liquidity positions, transaction monitoring, controls, and regulatory reporting. Collaborated with Treasury, Risk, AML/Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology stakeholders to define requirements, workflows, functional specifications, and process improvements. Experienced in Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery, requirements elicitation and analysis, BRD/FRD/SRS, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, gap and impact analysis, stakeholder management, UAT and production validation. Developed comprehensive project documentation, including requirement specifications, design documents, and test plans, to ensure clarity and alignment among stakeholders and project teams. Ensuring clear, sequential progression through requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment phases. Worked closely with product owners and stakeholders to prioritize and manage product backlogs, ensuring that the most valuable features are delivered first and aligned with business objectives.

logical_blocks.text:
Designation: Software Analyst
Project: One Trade (IBDIC), Trade Free Portal/Digi Trade (Au Bank):
One Trade is an enterprise Trade Finance platform that digitizes and automates end-to- end Trade Finance operations, including Letters of Credit (LC), Bank Guarantees (BG), Import & Export Finance, Foreign Remittances, Regulatory Reporting, and Customer Portal services. The application integrates with Core Banking Systems and multiple third-party systems to streamline banking operations and enhance customer experience.
Trade Free is trade finance transaction processing system.
Collaborated with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, and Solution Architects to gather, analyze, and document business requirements. Conducted stakeholder workshops, requirement elicitation sessions, and business process analysis. Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement. Performed Gap Analysis and Impact Analysis for change requests and regulatory enhancements. Designed business process flows, UML diagrams, wireframes, and screen mock-ups. Created User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Business Rules, and Functional Workflows. Worked closely with Development and QA teams to clarify functional requirements and support implementation. Participated in Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, Backlog Grooming, and Agile ceremonies. Coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, and production validation. Acted as the functional point of contact for client discussions and requirement sign-offs.

Role: Business Analyst Designation: Deputy Manager-II
Project: Enhancement of Omniflow- Trade Finance Application:
Omniflow software application was developed for scalable, flexible trade finance solution that meets evolving needs of the bank. Omniflow is a Trade Finance platform supporting international trade transactions, including Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Import & Export Finance, Foreign Remittances, FDI, ODI, and External Commercial Borrowings (ECB).
Key Responsibilities:
Managed Trade Finance Operations, encompassing Letter of Credit, Bank
Guarantee, Inward Remittance, Outward Remittance, FDI, ODI, and ECB.
Oversaw international trade finance activities, ensuring strict compliance. Streamlined Trade transactions, ensuring seamless flow and maximizing customer satisfaction by maintaining turnaround time.
Utilized Waterfall methodology, ensuring a structured and phased approach to project
completion
Collaborated with senior BA to create a Business Case Document and prepared a RACI
Matrix.
Conducted Stakeholder Analysis and gathered business requirements through various
elicitation techniques.

technical team
Developed UML diagrams and wireframes using MS Visio, Balsamiq, and Axure. Created and maintained a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) throughout the
project.
Assisted in preparing Test Case Scenarios and supported UAT to ensure successful
system validation.
